claim_text_zh: 王守仁（王阳明）生于明宪宗成化八年九月三十日（1472年10月26日或31日），浙江绍兴府余姚县瑞云楼。
claim_text_en: Wang Shouren (Wang Yangming) was born on the 30th day of the 9th month of the 8th year of the Chenghua reign (26 or 31 October 1472) at Ruiyun Tower, Yuyao County, Shaoxing Prefecture, Zhejiang Province.

date.original_date_text: 明宪宗成化八年九月三十日

place: 浙江绍兴府余姚县瑞云楼
review_note: 公历换算存在10月26日（英文维基）与10月31日（中文来源）差异，需核对明实录或年谱。

claim_text_zh: 王守仁本名王守仁。
claim_text_en: His original name was Wang Shouren.
review_note: Split from compound claim per central review. Original name only.

claim_text_zh: 王守仁，字伯安。
claim_text_en: His courtesy name (zi) was Bo'an.
review_note: Split from C002 per central review.

claim_text_zh: 王守仁号阳明子，世称王阳明。
claim_text_en: His art name (hao) was Yangmingzi; commonly known as Wang Yangming.
review_note: Split from C002 per central review.

claim_text_zh: 王阳明卒后谥号文成。
claim_text_en: He was posthumously titled Wencheng (Completion of Culture).
review_note: Split from C002 per central review.

claim_text_zh: 王阳明生前封新建伯，卒后追赠新建侯。
claim_text_en: He was enfeoffed as Earl of Xinjian during his lifetime, posthumously promoted to Marquis of Xinjian.
review_note: Split from C002 per central review.

claim_text_zh: 王阳明的父亲王华于成化十七年（1481年）中状元，官至南京吏部尚书。
claim_text_en: His father Wang Hua was the top-ranked jinshi (zhuangyuan) in 1481 and served as Nanjing Minister of Personnel.

claim_text_zh: 王阳明于弘治五年（1492年）中举人。
claim_text_en: He passed the provincial examination (juren) in 1492.

claim_text_zh: 王阳明于弘治十二年（1499年）中进士，名列二甲第七名。
claim_text_en: He passed the jinshi examination in 1499, placing seventh in the second class.

claim_text_zh: 正德元年（1506年），王阳明因上疏为被宦官刘瑾逮捕的言官戴铣等人辩护，遭廷杖四十，贬谪贵州龙场驿丞。
claim_text_en: In 1506, he submitted a memorial defending censors including Dai Xian who had been imprisoned by eunuch Liu Jin; he was punished with 40 strokes of the court rod and exiled to Guizhou as post-station master at Longchang.

claim_text_zh: 王阳明在龙场驿艰苦环境中静坐沉思，悟出“圣人之道，吾性自足”，形成其心学的基本洞见。后世称此为“龙场悟道”。
claim_text_en: At Longchang post station, in extreme hardship, through quiet meditation he realized that 'the Way of the Sage is complete within my own nature.' This event is later known as the 'Longchang Enlightenment.'
review_note: '龙场悟道'为后世命名。core insight confirmed; 'enlightenment' framing is reception.

claim_text_zh: 正德十一年（1516年），王阳明受命巡抚南赣（南赣巡抚），平定江西、福建、广东交界地区的民变。
claim_text_en: In 1516, he was appointed Grand Coordinator of Southern Jiangxi (Nangan) and suppressed peasant revolts in the border region of Jiangxi, Fujian, and Guangdong.

claim_text_zh: 正德十四年（1519年）六月，宁王朱宸濠在南昌起兵叛乱。
claim_text_en: In June/July 1519, Prince of Ning Zhu Chenhao launched a rebellion from Nanchang.
review_note: Split from compound claim per central review. Rebellion outbreak only.

claim_text_zh: 王阳明集结约三万三千兵力应对宁王之乱。
claim_text_en: Wang Yangming assembled approximately 33,000 troops in response to the Prince of Ning rebellion.
review_note: Split from C009 per central review.

claim_text_zh: 王阳明于鄱阳湖之战中击败宁王叛军舰队，约三十五日平定叛乱。
claim_text_en: Wang Yangming defeated the rebel fleet at the Battle of Lake Poyang, suppressing the rebellion in approximately 35 days.
review_note: Split from C009 per central review.

claim_text_zh: 王阳明在平定宁王之乱中生擒朱宸濠。
claim_text_en: Wang Yangming captured Zhu Chenhao alive during the suppression of the Prince of Ning rebellion.
review_note: Split from C009 per central review.

claim_text_zh: 宁王之乱中，王阳明使用了心理战（伪造文书、离间、传单）以动摇叛军士气。
claim_text_en: During the Prince of Ning rebellion, Wang employed psychological warfare (forged documents, disinformation, leaflets) to undermine rebel morale.
review_note: Split from compound claim per central review. Psychological warfare only.

claim_text_zh: 宁王之乱中，王阳明使用了佛朗机炮（葡萄牙后膛炮），此为中文军事史料中对该武器的早期记载之一。
claim_text_en: During the Prince of Ning rebellion, Wang used Portuguese breech-loading cannon (folangji) — one of the earliest Chinese military references to this weapon.
review_note: Split from C010 per central review. Needham (1986) vol.5 part 7 p.372.

claim_text_zh: 嘉靖六年（1527年），王阳明受命总督两广军务，平定思恩、田州土司之乱及断藤峡瑶民起事。
claim_text_en: In 1527, he was appointed Supreme Commander of Guangdong and Guangxi to suppress the Si'en and Tianzhou chieftain uprisings and the Yao rebellion at Duanteng Gorge.

claim_text_zh: 王阳明官至南京兵部尚书、都察院左都御史。
claim_text_en: He reached the rank of Nanjing Minister of War and Left Censor-in-Chief.

claim_text_zh: 后世哲学史将王阳明的哲学归入“陆王心学”（Lu-Wang School），视其为南宋陆九渊心学思想的继承者，与朱熹的程朱理学形成对峙格局。此分类为后世哲学史建构，非王阳明或其同时代人使用的自我标识。
claim_text_en: Later historiographers classify Wang Yangming's philosophy as part of the 'Lu-Wang School of Mind,' viewing it as continuing the thought of Southern Song philosopher Lu Jiuyuan and standing in opposition to Zhu Xi's Cheng-Zhu School of Principle. This classification is a later historiographical construction.
review_note: Rewritten per central review: reception/scholarly_interpretation framing.

claim_text_zh: 王阳明提出“知行合一”说：知与行不可分割，真知必能行，不行不足为知。
claim_text_en: He proposed the doctrine of 'unity of knowledge and action' (zhixing heyi): knowledge and action are inseparable; genuine knowledge necessarily leads to action, and knowledge without action is not true knowledge.
review_note: 核心学说，出自传习录和龙场时期论述。

claim_text_zh: 王阳明提出“致良知”说：人人天生具有辨别善恶的良知，修养在于去除私欲遮蔽以恢复此良知。
claim_text_en: He proposed the doctrine of 'extension of innate knowledge' (zhi liangzhi): every person is born with an innate moral knowing (liangzhi); self-cultivation consists of removing selfish desires that obscure it.
review_note: 晚期核心学说。

claim_text_zh: 王阳明提出“心即理”说：理不在心外，心即是理。
claim_text_en: He proposed that 'the mind is principle' (xin ji li): principle does not exist outside the mind; the mind itself is principle.

claim_text_zh: 嘉靖六年（1527年）出征广西前，王阳明在天泉桥与弟子王畿、钱德洪论道。后世称此为“天泉证道”。
claim_text_en: In 1527 before departing for Guangxi, Wang Yangming held a philosophical dialogue with disciples Wang Ji and Qian Dehong at Tianquan Bridge. This is later known as the 'Tianquan Bridge Teaching' (Tianquan zhengdao).
review_note: Split from compound claim per central review. Tianquan Bridge event only.

claim_text_zh: 天泉证道中，王阳明提出“四句教”：无善无恶心之体，有善有恶意之动，知善知恶是良知，为善去恶是格物。其文字出自《传习录》，为门人所记。
claim_text_en: At the Tianquan Bridge Teaching, Wang Yangming delivered the Four-Sentence Teaching: 'The substance of the mind is without good or evil; the movement of intention involves good and evil; knowing good and evil is innate knowledge; doing good and eliminating evil is the investigation of things.' The text is preserved in the Chuanxilu as recorded by disciples.
review_note: Split from C017 per central review.

claim_text_zh: 学者指出王阳明的哲学具有激进的平等主义含义：人人皆可通过去除私欲而成圣。此为后世学术解读。
claim_text_en: Scholars note that Wang Yangming's philosophy has a radical egalitarian implication: all people are equally capable of becoming a sage through the removal of selfish desires. This is a scholarly interpretation.
review_note: Downgraded to reception/scholarly_interpretation per central review.

claim_text_zh: 王阳明卒于明世宗嘉靖七年十一月二十九日（1529年1月9日），卒于江西南安府青龙铺舟中，享年五十七岁（虚岁）。
claim_text_en: He died on the 29th day of the 11th month of the 7th year of the Jiajing reign (9 January 1529) on a boat at Qinglongpu, Nan'an Prefecture, Jiangxi, aged 57 sui.

date.original_date_text: 嘉靖七年十一月二十九日

place: 江西南安府青龙铺（今大余县）

claim_text_zh: 王阳明葬于浙江山阴洪溪乡鲜虾山（今绍兴市柯桥区兰亭镇）。
claim_text_en: He was buried at Xianxia Mountain, Hongxi Township, Shanyin (modern Lanting, Keqiao District, Shaoxing, Zhejiang).

claim_text_zh: 隆庆元年（1567年），王阳明被追赠新建侯，谥文成。
claim_text_en: In 1567, Wang Yangming was posthumously promoted to Marquis of Xinjian and given the posthumous title Wencheng (Completion of Culture).

claim_text_zh: 万历十二年（1584年），王阳明获从祀孔庙——这是对儒家学者的最高荣誉之一。
claim_text_en: In 1584, Wang Yangming was offered sacrifice in the Confucian Temple (congsi kongmiao) — one of the highest honors for a Confucian scholar.

claim_text_zh: 王阳明在后世儒学史中常与孔子、孟子、朱熹并称为中国儒学史上的重要人物。
claim_text_en: Wang Yangming is often ranked in later Confucian historiography alongside Confucius, Mencius, and Zhu Xi among the most important figures in Chinese Confucian history.
review_note: 此为后世评价，非生前事实。“孔孟朱王”并称为后世学术史建构。

claim_text_zh: 后世常以“真三不朽”（立德、立功、立言）评价王阳明，视其为中国历史上少有的文武兼备人物。
claim_text_en: In later reception, Wang Yangming is often credited with achieving the 'True Three Immortalities' (establishing virtue, merit, and teaching), viewed as one of the rare figures in Chinese history who excelled in both civil and military affairs.
review_note: “真三不朽”为后世评价框架，非生前事实。

claim_text_zh: 王阳明心学传入日本后形成“日本阳明学”（Ōyōmei-gaku），江户时代学者中江藤树被视为日本阳明学之祖。
claim_text_en: After Wang Yangming's thought was transmitted to Japan, it formed 'Japanese Yangmingism' (Ōyōmei-gaku). Edo-period scholar Nakae Tōju is regarded as its founder in Japan.
review_note: Downgraded to reception per central review. SRC016 (Ching 1984) + SRC017 (Steben 1998) provide verified Nakae Toju coverage; SRC014 (Ching 1976) Japan pages unverified.

claim_text_zh: 日本阳明学影响了幕末维新人物的思想，如西乡隆盛、高杉晋作等。
claim_text_en: Japanese Yangmingism influenced late Tokugawa figures including Saigō Takamori and Takasugi Shinsaku.
review_note: Downgraded to reception per central review. SRC018 (Najita 1980) verified: Oyomei only on p.54 re Oshio Heihachiro, Takasugi on pp.61/64/65 without Yangming link, Saigo not mentioned. No explicit connection between Yangming thought and Saigo/Takasugi in SRC018. SRC014 (Ching 1976) Japan pages unverified. Needs dedicated source on late Tokugawa Yangmingism (\( rac{1}{4}\)Oshio Heihachiro, Kawai Tsugunosuke, etc.).

claim_text_zh: 王阳明也是一位书法家，但传世具体书法作品馆藏信息需核实。
claim_text_en: Wang Yangming was also a calligrapher, but specific museum holdings of his calligraphy require verification.
review_note: 一般书法史常提及其善书，但具体馆藏编号、作品名称未核实。

claim_text_zh: 传说王阳明幼时五岁仍不能言，改名守仁后始开口。其祖母曾梦神人自云中送子，故初名王云。
claim_text_en: Legend holds that Wang Yangming did not speak until age five, beginning only after being renamed Shouren. His grandmother allegedly dreamed of a spirit delivering a child from the clouds, hence his childhood name Wang Yun.
review_note: 此为后世传说，典型的神童叙事。Dictionary of Ming Biography提及此故事。
